headline: MIC Electronics Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - MIC Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of in-principle approval from the stock exchanges for the issue of Equity Shares on a preferential basis towards the acquisition of M/s. NEO Semi SG Pte…
detail: General Updates - MIC Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of in-principle approval from the stock exchanges for the issue of Equity Shares on a preferential basis towards the acquisition of M/s. NEO Semi SG Pte Ltd, Singapore.

sources.name: NSE filing - MIC Electronics Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
